classification: Post-outcome read-only diagnosis of every missing fresh urllib3 evidence group; this corpus is now observed. No retrieval, model, tuning, gold or producer changes.

method.imports: Python standard library only; no producer, selector, backend, retrieval, index or model imports.
method.evidence: Independent physical CR/LF splitting; OR within each group, AND across all groups; one literal actually delivered excerpt must contain the entire pinned executable evidence span. Source SHA256 and evidence SHA256 checked. Symbols alone do not establish coverage.
method.stage_limits: ranked/selected/eligible are captured full-source stages, not evidence delivery. ranked_cap8 and anchors are descriptive prefixes of the captured deduplicated order. character_packed is independently reconstructed by taking whole physical lines in eligible order under 12,000 shared characters. token_packed_prepost and final are actual raw delivered rows.
method.earliest_exclusion: For each final missing group, identify the latest surviving captured source stage and its next exclusion; distinguish raw absence, same-definition/display window suppression, rank cap, dependency displacement, character clipping, token clipping and postprocessing. Extraction eligibility is retained separately.
method.independence_limit: This is a diagnostic stage attribution, not a new independent quality experiment or a new algorithm candidate.
